Designing a reliable file backup system is not merely about copying data from one disk to another; it is about building a **resilience strategy**. A backup is only reliable if it can be verified, restored quickly, and protected from the very threats it is meant to guard against (such as ransomware or hardware failure).

Here is a detailed guide on designing a professional-grade backup system.
